_comment: Hand-written reference spec for test_vector_files/detal_126.png (Шпиндель
обрабатывающего центра V-10, Сталь 55 ГОСТ 1050-2013, М 1:2, A3).
Purpose: isolate the DRAFTER. Every number here was read off the sheet by
hand, so anything the drafter gets wrong from this input is the drafter's
own defect and not a reading error. It is the baseline for 'is it the
drafter?' — nothing more.
The axial chain read from the sheet is 78 / 150 / 240 / 470 from the left
face, 270 spanning the right portion, and 25 / 18 / 3 / 50 / 25 plus
35 / 99 around the nose. The outer steps below are reconstructed from that
chain and sum to the stated overall length of 470.
WHAT THIS SPEC CANNOT SAY, because the contract has no field for it —
SpecSection is a diameter and a length, nothing else:
- the 7:24 taper of the bore (Ø56,55 large end) — carried as a cylinder
- the M75x1,5 and M54,5x2 threads
- both keyways (85x12 and 35, R4/R6)
- the cross-holes Ø14, Ø10, Ø9 and the 2 отв. M8 of section Б-Б
- the 1x45° chamfers ('6 фасок')
- the GD&T frames (0,008 Д, 0,03 Д) as geometry rather than text
So a 100% reproduction of THIS sheet is out of reach for reasons that have
nothing to do with the drafter or the reader: the contract cannot carry
the features. What the drafter can be held to is this spec, exactly.
